english.note: Use 點火正時 specifically for the synchronization of spark-plug firing in an internal-combustion engine.

examples.english: The mechanic said the engine's timing was off, so it was not running smoothly.
examples.traditional: 師傅話部車嘅點火正時唔啱，所以引擎運作唔順。
